title: Ya Zahra Ali
body:
Ya Zahra Ali
<<MINI>>
Momino qissa e sadaat suno
thaam kar dil ye meri baat suno
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon se likhe huwe halaat suno
ya zahra, ya zahra, ya zahra, ya zahra..(2)
<<MINI>>
ya zahra, ali, ya zahra, ali, ya zahra, ali, ya zahra
Momino qissa e sadaat suno
thaam kar dil ye meri baat suno
<<DIVIDER>>
noor e kaunain madina hai jaha'n
ek mahella bani hashim hai waha'n
ek mahelle ke ek ghar ka bayaa'n
jisse behtar nahi duniya mein makaa'n
<<DIVIDER>>
deen o eemaan ke kirdaar ka ghar
panjetan paak ke anwaar ka ghar
dukhtar e Ahmed e mukhtar ka ghar
fatima haider e qarrar ka ghar
<<DIVIDER>>
laadle..(3), inke hasan aur hussain aur do betiya'n thi noor e ayn
ek kulsoom thi, ek baap ka zayn aur abbas dilo jaan ka chayn
ghar ye tha bayt e khuda
jisme qur'aa utra aur kis tarha luta
<<DIVIDER>>
inka rutba na zamana samjha
<<MINI>>
ya zahra, ali, ya zahra, ali, ya zahra, ali, ya zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaisi mazloom magar thi zahra
baap ke ghum me bhi rone na diya
haq se mehroom kiya wa abata
aaj bhi jiski lahad be saaya
<<DIVIDER>>
jispe jalta huwa darwaza gira
hogayi pehlu shakista zahra
qatl mohsin bhi hua wawaila
baad e zehra wo ali ka girya
<<DIVIDER>>
masjide..(3), kufa me phir shor utha
haaye haider pe chali teghe jafa
thi sada fusto be rabbil kaaba
ghar mein zehra ke qayamat thi bapa
<<DIVIDER>>
sar se saaya jo utha
ghar ye veeran huwa
thi yateemo ki buka
haaye baba, haaye baba baba
<<MINI>>
ya zahra, ali, ya zahra, ali, ya zahra, ali, ya zahra..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Baad e haider ye sitam aur huwa
khoo'n mein shabbar ka janaza dooba aur phir deen jo mushkil mein ghira
tab hussain ibn e ali ghar se chala
karbala jaise hi pohcha kunba phir to kya zulm na sayyed pe huwa
<<DIVIDER>>
milke laakho'n ne unhe gher liya
teen din pehle to paani na diya aur phir..(3)
maqtale sadaat sajaa
bhanje, bete, bhatija na raha
<<DIVIDER>>
na wo lashkar na alamadaar bacha
asr se pehle wo halmin ki sadaa
chal gayi teghe jafa
khoon bekas ka baha
<<DIVIDER>>
sar suwe naiza gaya
tan ko aghosh me zehra ne liya
<<MINI>>
ya zahra, ali, ya zahra, ali, ya zahra, ali, ya zahra..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Aa gayi shaam e ghareeba'n haye haye aur phir aag lagi khaime jale
ghash se jab aabid e beemar uthe
qaidi kunbe ke wo salaar bane
haaye sajjad ne kya kya dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
sar khule shaam me kunba dekha
jashn darbaar mein hota dekha
choti hamsheer ka laasha dekha
qaid se..(3), chutke chale karbobala
<<DIVIDER>>
sab ka chehlum kiya matam bhi kiya
qafila jab ye madine pohcha
ab baya'n sarwar o rehan ho kya
haye matam tha bapa
<<DIVIDER>>
jab ye zainab ne kaha
na rahi meri rida
amma mai aagayi bhai na raha
<<MINI>>
ya zahra, ali, ya zahra, ali, ya zahra, ali, ya zahra..(2)
